title: agent-watcher: stop double-counting Codex processes
description:
`LiveCodexProcessFinder` and the snapshot-based finder match both the `node .../codex` wrapper and its native child, so one agent counts as two processes. `CodexScanner.Scan` pairs processes with rollouts by working directory and time, so the spare PID can claim another rollout.

Observed: one wrapper and child pair in a single directory claimed two top-level rollouts, and other pairs claimed subagent rollouts under separate PIDs. At least one of those two rollouts is falsely active, which would produce a warning about an agent that has finished.

Drop a Codex process whose parent is also a Codex process, and add a regression test built from a wrapper and child pair.
